origin.description: Alias of checkCount. Returns true, or a message, after testing whether the value is a single count, zero or more.
origin.usage: check_count(x, na.ok = FALSE, positive = FALSE, tol = sqrt(.Machine$double.eps), null.ok = FALSE)

arguments.name: x
arguments.text: Value under test. A Python int is an R integer and a Python float is an R double.

arguments.name: na.ok
arguments.text: When true, one missing value is allowed.

arguments.name: positive
arguments.text: When true, the count must be at least 1.

arguments.name: tol
arguments.text: How far a number may sit from an integer.

origin.details: Alias of checkCount. Returns true, or a message, after testing whether the value is a single count, zero or more.
origin.value: True, or a message describing the first failure.
